rationale: The instrument gapped down ~2.26% and has been recovering intraday, with price now at the top of today's range (position 100%) and well above VWAP ($36.91) and the 9-EMA ($36.72), suggesting the initial selling pressure has been absorbed. Waiting for additional price structure to develop is the prudent choice.
